resource.conclusion: Peripheral blood immunophenotyping reveals a monoclonal B-cell population consistent with CLL. Cells are positive for CD5, CD19, CD20 (dim), CD23, and show kappa light chain restriction. Minimal residual disease detected at 2.3% of lymphocytes.

resource.conclusion: IMPRESSION: 1. Multiple enlarged retroperitoneal and mesenteric lymph nodes, largest measuring 2.1 x 1.5 cm in the para-aortic region. Overall slightly decreased in size compared to prior study dated 2149-06-18. 2. Mild splenomegaly measuring 13.2 cm in greatest dimension, stable. 3. No ascites or liver lesions. 4. Status post gastric bypass, expected postoperative appearance.
